ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within square $ABCD$, an equilateral triangle $\triangle ADE$ is constructed. By connecting $BE$ and $CE$, what is the measure of $\angle CBE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ADE$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
it follows that $AE=DE=AD$, and $\angle ADE=\angle EAD=\angle AED=60^\circ$,\\
Since quadrilateral ABCD is a square,\\
it follows that $AB=AD=DC$, and $\angle BAD=\angle ADC=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BAE=\angle CDE=90^\circ-60^\circ=30^\circ$, and $AB=AE=DE=CD$,\\
hence $\angle ABE=\frac{1}{2}\left(180^\circ-30^\circ\right)=75^\circ=\angle DCE$,\\
thus $\angle CBE=90^\circ-75^\circ=\boxed{15^\circ}$.
